invariant_bindings.invariant_text: An exception raised by an estimator MUST NOT propagate out of `estimate_request()` — cost observation is always fail-open.
`_history` length MUST NEVER exceed `_max_history`; the oldest entry is evicted FIFO when the bound is hit.
`total_cost_usd` on the returned estimate MUST equal `db_cost_usd + s3_cost_usd + api_cost_usd` (conservation).
